desk.name: Cobalt Ridge Logistics IT Service Desk
desk.brief: You are on the Tier-1 desk for the Monday morning shift. Fifteen cases came in overnight and since 07:00. Triage every case using the routing guide: set its category, priority and owner team, decide whether it needs escalation, and merge duplicates into the earliest case. Where the guide says a requester needs a reply, write it. Your work saves as you go.

blocks.text: Choose the category from what is actually wrong, not from the requester's guess. The category decides the owner team.
Priority comes from impact (how many people are affected) and urgency (whether their work has stopped).

rows: A whole site, or more than 20 people

items: Executives and anyone with a board, audit or customer deadline today: raise the priority by one level.
Security cases are never lower than P2.
Words like URGENT, ASAP or exclamation marks do not change the priority.

blocks.text: When two cases report the same problem (the same outage, or the same requester with the same issue), merge the later case into the earliest one. A merged case keeps no routing of its own.

items: Any sign that data was exposed, credentials were entered on a suspicious page, or malware ran: escalate to Security incident response.
Every P1: escalate to the Duty manager.
A device showing a disk or battery failure warning: escalate to Vendor support.
If more than one applies, Security incident response wins.
Otherwise choose Not escalated. Every escalation needs a one-line reason.

blocks.text: Reply only to every Security case and to every request to install new software. All other cases get no reply from the desk: the owner team contacts the requester.

items: Greet the requester by name and quote the case number and its priority.
Give the first-response target for that priority: P1 30 minutes, P2 2 working hours, P3 1 working day, P4 3 working days. Never promise a fix time.
Ask only for the details listed below for the case's category.
Never ask for a password or a one-time code.
Security cases: tell the requester to change their password now in the self-service portal and not to delete or forward the suspicious email.

rows: Username and the exact error message
Asset tag and what the screen shows when it starts
Location and whether colleagues are affected
Mailbox name and the time of one affected message
Software name and version, business reason, approving manager
What was clicked or entered, and when

cases.subject: Can't sign in after password reset
cases.body: Hi, I reset my password on Friday from home and now the laptop says the password is incorrect. I can't get into anything this morning. Thanks, Priya

cases.subject: All Dock B scanners offline
cases.body: Every handheld scanner at Dock B (22 of them) dropped off the Wi-Fi at about 07:40. The pickers can't scan anything, so loading has stopped for the whole shift.

cases.subject: URGENT!!! second monitor
cases.body: URGENT!!! I need a second monitor for my desk, it would make my work much easier. Whenever you can get to it is fine, but please treat as urgent.

cases.subject: Scanner won't connect
cases.body: My scanner shows 'No network' and so do the ones next to me. We are all standing around at Dock B.

cases.subject: Invoice email asked me to log in
cases.body: I opened an invoice email from a supplier I don't recognise and clicked the link. It asked me to sign in with my work account so I did, then the page went blank. I'm worried I did something wrong. Should I delete the email?

cases.subject: Care mailbox not getting new mail
cases.body: The shared customer care mailbox hasn't received anything since about 06:30. The six of us can still answer older emails, but nothing new is arriving.

cases.subject: VPN keeps dropping
cases.body: My VPN disconnects every 20 minutes or so. I can reconnect and keep working, it's just annoying.

cases.subject: Laptop won't start
cases.body: My laptop shows 'Disk failure imminent' and then won't start, even after a restart. I present to the board at 11:00 today.

cases.subject: Diagram tool says licence expired
cases.body: The diagramming tool opens in read-only mode and says my licence expired. I can still look at my diagrams, I just can't edit them until it's renewed.

cases.subject: Laptop broken
cases.body: I think my laptop is broken. When I type my password it says 'Your account has been locked. Contact your administrator.' I can't do any work.

cases.subject: Payroll app display glitch
cases.body: The payroll app looks odd this morning. When I opened my payslip it showed another employee's name, bank details and salary instead of mine. Two people on my team say the same happened to them. Everything else seems to work.

cases.subject: Screen sharing broken in every meeting room
cases.body: Screen sharing fails in all 14 meeting rooms in the head office building. Calls still work, people are just reading slides out loud.

cases.subject: Please install Python
cases.body: Could you install Python on my laptop? I'd like to automate a weekly report. No rush.

cases.subject: Break room Wi-Fi slow
cases.body: The Wi-Fi in the second-floor break room is slow for the eight of us who eat lunch there. Not a big deal, but could someone look at it this week?

cases.subject: Still can't get in
cases.body: Following up on my email from last night. My new password still isn't accepted, so I'm still stuck.
